source_note: Weierstrass逼近定理的概率途径证明
english_source_note: A Probabilistic Proof of the Weierstrass Approximation Theorem
callout_id: Weierstrass逼近定理的概率途径证明#15
statement_en:
Let $
u,\mu$ be two measures on the measurable space $(\Omega,\mathcal{F})$, and let $g$ be a nonnegative Borel measurable function on $\Omega$. If the density $ rac{d
u}{d\mu}$ of $
u$ with respect to $\mu$ exists, then
$$\int_{\Omega}g\,d
u=\int_{\Omega}g rac{d
u}{d\mu}\,d\mu.$$
key_techniques: integration with respect to absolutely continuous measures
